Do not try to chase liberation or it will become an ever retreating sunset, winking away over horizons ever pronouncing the squandering of efforts with the night's beguiling chill, and light escaping over the cusp of dusk will be a somber, haunting taunt. No, let liberation shine in posterity as a well established dawn, risen of its own accord, predestined and determined. Feel its glow at your back, and treat it as if it were the only thing time-worn that time could not vanquish. Let your liberty nourish like summer rays, the benefactor of all unguarded pursuits, a fire lit before the dream of your age, in worship of the freedom that is our very ground, our timeless edifice, and unblinking authority. Let it be a brilliance that shines even through the shutters of the mind, a radiance that warms despite the frigidity of our willing, and let it be a proof that dissolves the seeker and the questioner. Receive it as your only true possession, even though it's bound to no one. It is free because its nature is to give itself without solicitation nor prejudice nor end. It is yours because there is nothing else than what is being given. The timeless can never be yet to come.
